description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 score for different dense passage retrieval (DPR) methods. The x-axis is labeled “# queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 4 to 8, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.5 to 35.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A black solid line with circle markers represents “DPR w/o query expansion”, starting at approximately 34.7 when x equals 4, decreasing to 34.6 when x equals 8. A red solid line with triangle markers represents “DPR w/ corpus expansion”, beginning at approximately 34.2 when x equals 4, increasing to 34.9 when x equals 8. A green solid line with diamond markers represents “DPR w/ document expansion”, starting at approximately 34.1 when x equals 4, increasing to 34.6 when x equals 8. A blue solid line with square markers represents “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”, beginning at approximately 34.6 when x equals 4, decreasing to 34.4 when x equals 8.
